title: Separate exchange incident balances and institutional collateral by ownership, recognition, encumbrance and time cutoff

decisions.rule: Store receiver balances with explicit chain and observation cutoff. A no-movement finding is valid only through the stated cutoff. Separate exact transfer sums from rounded provider balance reports and preserve chain-count/provider attribution disagreements.

Keep recognized lending collateral, borrower collateral not recognized, institution-owned assets pledged against borrowings and customer derivatives collateral in separate pools. Never sum them as free liquidity or infer XRP from an aggregate other-crypto bucket.
Do not admit Coinbase collateral totals as XRP features without token-specific evidence and a verified ownership/usage classification.
